Library Board
  MINUTES – July 24, 2024
The Inglewood Library Board met on July 24, 2024, via Zoom. Board Member Pat Douglas called the
meeting to order at 4:34 pm.

Roll Call

Present:
  Joyce Garner – District 1 Board Member
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Management Assistant
  Isabella Velasco – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for March 27, 2024.
  Board Member Castillo seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

Library Report

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo gave the library updates: A great turnout from this year's Summer Reading
Program, which had 478 participants; 5 Saturday programs, which had 1100 attendees; Provided surveys
and received a lot of feedback; Grants that the library received; Giveaways for back-to-school; National Night
 Out Program; Library Ad at The Cinepolis in Inglewood; Feedback from library employees about their
perspective of their favorite thing at the library.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board Member Castillo thanked Library Manager Kerri Arroyo for finding opportunities to connect
  with the School District. He stated that he’s very excited that the library provides resources, whether
  information or a place where students can study. Board Member Castillo informed the board that this
  was his last board meeting. He has to resign from the library board. He is also on the school board
  and was unaware that he couldn't be on two boards simultaneously.

  Board Member Douglas stated that this was an excellent report. It's great for the community, schools,
  and parents that they have a safe environment to go to and have fun in. She also stated that the
  library had come a long way in adherence and perceptions of what it actually does.

With no further comments, the meeting adjourned at 4:56 pm.
